Work the strongest fact first: a death tells you who to find (survivors in the obituary, heirs by law); unpaid taxes tell you how much time there is (the county may sue once a bill is two years old, and there is no redemption after the sale date); a condition note tells you what the house is. Confirm the tax balance on the Treasurer's site and the title in the Clerk's records before you contact anyone.
